executive_summary: The cybersecurity landscape remains at a HIGH threat level, characterized by critical path traversal and authorization vulnerabilities in enterprise-grade infrastructure. New disclosures affecting WSO2 and Adobe Commerce underscore a persistent risk of remote code execution and unauthorized access. Organizations must prioritize patching these systems, specifically adhering to CISA’s BOD 26-04 guidelines for risk-based prioritization and forensic triage to mitigate potential exploitation of these high-EPSS vulnerabilities.
key_takeaways: Critical path traversal vulnerabilities in WSO2 and Adobe Commerce require immediate patching to prevent RCE and unauthorized data access.
The release of Qwen-Image-2.1 and its uncensored GGUF variant marks a significant shift in accessible, high-performance text-to-image capabilities.
Developer tooling is trending toward local, high-efficiency decision models, as evidenced by the rapid adoption of Laya-coreml and ZCode.
F-Droid 2.0 launch signals a major update in the open-source Android ecosystem, warranting review for secure application distribution strategies.
EPSS scores for Adobe Commerce (0.02335) and Check Point (0.02421) indicate a high probability of active exploitation; prioritize these for immediate remediation.

cves.title: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
cves.description: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-provided patches immediately and follow CISA BOD 26-04 forensic triage requirements.

cves.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
cves.description: Incorrect authorization vulnerability allowing attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-provided patches immediately and follow CISA BOD 26-04 forensic triage requirements.

cves.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cves.description: Improper input validation allowing remote attacker access to privileged internal functionality.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-provided patches immediately and follow CISA BOD 26-04 forensic triage requirements.

cves.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cves.description: Heap-based buffer overflow when OAuth profile is configured, allowing unauthenticated RCE.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-provided iRule for temporary mitigation, then install final patch.

cves.title: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
cves.description: Path traversal allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor-provided patches immediately and follow CISA BOD 26-04 forensic triage requirements.
